description.en:
Walker C1 is UBTECH's full-size humanoid service platform for commercial and public-facing applications. It combines an articulated body with multimodal interaction and surrounding perception, allowing movement and gestures to accompany communication with visitors.

A built-in motion library supports predefined behaviors, while standard interfaces and an SDK allow application developers to customize movements and integrate services. UBTECH positions the platform for a range of human-oriented environments and interactive events. Its practical role depends on the installed application, site configuration and available sensing, with development tools providing a way to adapt the robot beyond its initial demonstrations.
description.zh:
### 产品概述

Walker C1是一款面向城市共生场景的全尺寸商用服务人形机器人，融合功能美学、灵活运动、多模态智能与具身智能技术，可为多种商业场景提供智能服务。
